relationships.subject: rheumatoid arthritis
relationships.evidence_quote: we suggest the existence of a sensitization of TRPV1 channels in RA patients caused by long-time chronical inflammation

key_findings: Topical capsaicin had a weaker effect on heat and mechanical pain thresholds in RA patients in remission than in healthy subjects, interpreted as TRPV1 sensitization.
CHEP amplitude changes after capsaicin diverged between RA and healthy subjects, possibly unmasking neuropathic symptoms.
